svg.title: How travel footage becomes a film
svg.desc: Five stages: recover the trip with footage, Photos GPS and email; find the story and record narration; edit picture and sound; review with Replay, speech tools and human judgment; approve delivery and save project memory. Review loops back to editing. Illustrative devices and interfaces are not screenshots.
